==Biography==
Reapered started his online gaming career playing Chaos at the age of 14. He managed to hold top rank in Chaos for a time. After a while though he was feeling that the game wasn't as mentally challenging as he wanted, that is when his friend introduced him to League of Legends.<ref>[http://lol.teamazubu.com/team-info/ Azubu's Player site] ''teamazubu.com''</ref>

On January 22, 2014, he annouced his retirement from professional gaming.<ref>[http://www.inven.co.kr/webzine/news/?news=102899&site=lol <nowiki>[취재]</nowiki> 선수 생활 마감한 '래퍼드' 복한규, "완전히 떠나는 것 아니다."(Korean)] ''inven.co.kr''</ref>

In April, 2015,  he joined [[EDward Gaming]] as coach.<ref>[http://www.fomos.kr/bbs_detail.php?bbs_num=702&id=&tb=news_lol 중국 EDG, ‘래퍼드’ 복한규 코치 선임…전력 강화되나 (Korean)] ''fomos.kr''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* His favorite champions are {{ci|Shaco}} and {{ci|Irelia}}.<ref>[http://www.thisisgame.com/board/view.php?id=1124185&category=13735 ''"MiG Blaze Team Interview"'']</ref>
* His summoner name ''"Reapered"'' is a combination of two words, ''"Reaper"'' and ''"D"'' (which is an abbreviation of Death).
* He was once ranked number 2 in the NA solo queue ladder.
* Popularized {{ii|Spirit of the Spectral Wraith}} (before the Season 4 changes to the item) as a core item for {{ci|Vladimir}}.
* Was a part of MiG Blaze when they won the first ever OGN season.
